about: Lot -> best library plan (one MW source per lot). Key = lot id of the coverage file (City of Vancouver property-tax roll id; no licensed property records (local only) values). best = the fitting plan with the most MW (ties: fits more lots, then fewer storeys); its MW, storey-1 footprint, storeys, outdoor generators and yard come from the library export. "no plan fits" = the Engineering cards keep their own sizing, labelled "rough size, no plan fits this lot". Generated by from the live kept set; regenerate after every rebuild. Each layout also carries its own outdoor data-centre generators as figures only (generatorUnits: count, kW, model; generatorKW = their sum), read from its plant list (project decision); the Emergency hub refuge generator is its own field (refugeGenerator) and is not in generators. FC-2 lots are left out (zone not yet in the tool).
